title: Core Action to Tensor Displacement Translation
purpose: Represent core-domain symmetry-breaking action in tensor mechanics as displacement without collapsing the two domains.
rule_meaning: A core symmetry-breaking action is represented in tensor mechanics as a displacement trace.
preserved_distinctions: action is not identical to displacement
observable identity is downstream of action and displacement
inverse_warning: ΔA may imply a core action trace, but the tensor displacement alone does not exhaust the full RT action context.
forbidden_collapses: Do not reduce action to mere geometric displacement.
Do not reduce displacement to an inert stored object.
Do not reverse the direction so that observation becomes prior to action.
Do not treat the translation as identity equivalence.
